lines.zh: 今天是我第一天上课。
lines.en: Today is my first day of class.
lines.pinyin: jīntiān shì wǒ dì-yī tiān shàngkè

lines.zh: 老师问我的名字，我说我叫张明。
lines.en: The teacher asked my name; I said I'm called Zhang Ming.
lines.pinyin: lǎoshī wèn wǒ de míngzi wǒ shuō wǒ jiào zhāng míng

lines.zh: 她说：你好，我是你们的老师。
lines.en: She said: hello, I am your teacher.
lines.pinyin: tā shuō nǐ hǎo wǒ shì nǐmen de lǎoshī

lines.zh: 教室里一共有十个人。
lines.en: There are ten people in the classroom altogether.
lines.pinyin: jiàoshì lǐ yígòng yǒu shí ge rén

lines.zh: 一、二、三、四、五，我先数了五个女生。
lines.en: One, two, three, four, five — first I counted five girls.
lines.pinyin: yí èr sān sì wǔ wǒ xiān shù le wǔ ge nǚshēng

lines.zh: 六、七、八、九、十，后面还有五个男生。
lines.en: Six, seven, eight, nine, ten — behind them were five boys.
lines.pinyin: liù qī bā jiǔ shí hòumiàn hái yǒu wǔ ge nánshēng

lines.zh: 我的新朋友坐在我旁边。
lines.en: My new friend sat beside me.
lines.pinyin: wǒ de xīn péngyou zuò zài wǒ pángbiān

lines.zh: 他给我写了他的电话号码，里面有三个零。
lines.en: He wrote down his phone number for me; it had three zeros in it.
lines.pinyin: tā gěi wǒ xiě le tā de diàn huà hàomǎ lǐmiàn yǒu sān ge líng

lines.zh: 下课的时候，他忘了自己的本子。
lines.en: When class ended, he forgot his own notebook.
lines.pinyin: xiàkè de shíhou tā wàng le zìjǐ de běnzi

lines.zh: 我拿着本子跑出去，可是他已经走了。
lines.en: I ran out holding the notebook, but he had already left.
lines.pinyin: wǒ ná zhe běnzi pǎo chū qù kě shì tā yǐjīng zǒu le

lines.zh: 下午我在家里找到一个包。
lines.en: In the afternoon I found a bag at home.
lines.pinyin: xiàwǔ wǒ zài jiā lǐ zhǎo dào yí ge bāo

lines.zh: 这个包不是我的，也不是我们家的。
lines.en: This bag isn't mine, and it isn't our family's either.
lines.pinyin: zhè ge bāo bú shì wǒ de yě bú shì wǒmen jiā de

lines.zh: 我问爸爸：这是谁的？
lines.en: I asked Dad: whose is this?
lines.pinyin: wǒ wèn bàba zhè shì shéi de

lines.zh: 他说：不知道，你去问妈妈吧。
lines.en: He said: no idea, go and ask Mum.
lines.pinyin: tā shuō bù zhīdào nǐ qù wèn māma ba

lines.zh: 妈妈说：可能是你姐姐的，她今天来过。
lines.en: Mum said: maybe it's your elder sister's, she came today.
lines.pinyin: māma shuō kěnéng shì nǐ jiějie de tā jīntiān lái guò

lines.zh: 我打开包，里面有几本书和多少钱？
lines.en: I opened the bag — inside were a few books, and how much money?
lines.pinyin: wǒ dǎ kāi bāo lǐmiàn yǒu jǐ běn shū hé duōshao qián

lines.zh: 一共两百块。
lines.en: Two hundred yuan altogether.
lines.pinyin: yígòng liǎng bǎi kuài

lines.zh: 我女儿走过来说：那是我的！
lines.en: My daughter came over and said: that's mine!
lines.pinyin: wǒ nǚ’ér zǒu guò lái shuō nà shì wǒ de

lines.zh: 她今年八岁，怎么会有这么多钱？
lines.en: She's eight this year — how could she have so much money?
lines.pinyin: tā jīnnián bā suì zěnme huì yǒu zhè me duō qián

lines.zh: 她笑着说：先生，我在帮小姐卖苹果。
lines.en: She said with a laugh: sir, I'm helping a young lady sell apples.
lines.pinyin: tā xiào zhe shuō xiānsheng wǒ zài bāng xiǎojiě mài píngguǒ

lines.zh: 我的同屋很能吃。
lines.en: My housemate can really eat.
lines.pinyin: wǒ de tóngwū hěn néng chī

lines.zh: 早上他吃了三个鸡蛋和一点儿米饭。
lines.en: In the morning he ate three eggs and a little rice.
lines.pinyin: zǎoshang tā chī le sān ge jīdàn hé yìdiǎnr mǐfàn

lines.zh: 他还喝了两杯茶。
lines.en: He also drank two cups of tea.
lines.pinyin: tā hái hē le liǎng bēi chá

lines.zh: 我问他：你都吃完了吗？
lines.en: I asked him: have you finished it all?
lines.pinyin: wǒ wèn tā nǐ dōu chī wán le ma

lines.zh: 他说：没有，我还想吃。
lines.en: He said: no, I still want to eat.
lines.pinyin: tā shuō méiyǒu wǒ hái xiǎng chī

lines.zh: 桌子上的东西太少了，他很不高兴。
lines.en: There was too little on the table and he was quite unhappy.
lines.pinyin: zhuōzi shàng de dōngxi tài shǎo le tā hěn bù gāoxìng

lines.zh: 晚上他一个人读书，一边读一边吃。
lines.en: In the evening he read alone, eating while he read.
lines.pinyin: wǎnshang tā yí ge rén dú shū yìbiān dú yìbiān chī

lines.zh: 我说：你能不能先读，后吃？
lines.en: I said: could you read first and eat afterwards?
lines.pinyin: wǒ shuō nǐ néng bù néng xiān dú hòu chī

lines.zh: 他看着我，什么也没说。
lines.en: He looked at me and said nothing at all.
lines.pinyin: tā kàn zhe wǒ shénme yě méi shuō

lines.zh: 第二天早上，冰箱是空的。
lines.en: The next morning the fridge was empty.
lines.pinyin: dì-èr tiān zǎoshang bīngxiāng shì kōng de

lines.zh: 我们今天搬家。
lines.en: We are moving house today.
lines.pinyin: wǒmen jīntiān bān jiā

lines.zh: 新房子很大，我很喜欢。
lines.en: The new house is very big and I like it a lot.
lines.pinyin: xīn fángzi hěn dà wǒ hěn xǐhuan

lines.zh: 我的同学开车来帮我。
lines.en: My classmate drove over to help me.
lines.pinyin: wǒ de tóngxué kāichē lái bāng wǒ

lines.zh: 他说：你想住在几楼？
lines.en: He said: which floor do you want to live on?
lines.pinyin: tā shuō nǐ xiǎng zhù zài jǐ lóu

lines.zh: 我说：三楼，因为楼下太吵。
lines.en: I said: the third floor, because downstairs is too noisy.
lines.pinyin: wǒ shuō sān lóu yīnwèi lóuxià tài chǎo

lines.zh: 我们把桌子和椅子都搬上去。
lines.en: We carried the tables and chairs all the way up.
lines.pinyin: wǒmen bǎ zhuōzi hé yǐzi dōu bān shàng qù

lines.zh: 然后我坐下来写了一张纸条。
lines.en: Then I sat down and wrote a note.
lines.pinyin: ránhòu wǒ zuò xià lái xiě le yì zhāng zhǐtiáo

lines.zh: 上面写着：欢迎回来，请做饭。
lines.en: It said: welcome back, please cook.
lines.pinyin: shàngmiàn xiě zhe huānyíng huí lái qǐng zuò fàn

lines.zh: 我的同学看见那张纸，笑得很大声。
lines.en: My classmate saw the note and laughed loudly.
lines.pinyin: wǒ de tóngxué kànjiàn nà zhāng zhǐ xiào de hěn dà shēng

lines.zh: 他说：我看你是不想让我走。
lines.en: He said: seems to me you don't want me to leave.
lines.pinyin: tā shuō wǒ kàn nǐ shì bù xiǎng ràng wǒ zǒu

lines.zh: 昨天我起床起晚了。
lines.en: Yesterday I got up late.
lines.pinyin: zuótiān wǒ qǐchuáng qǐ wǎn le

lines.zh: 那时候已经是上午九点半。
lines.en: By then it was already half past nine in the morning.
lines.pinyin: nà shíhou yǐjīng shì shàngwǔ jiǔ diǎn bàn

lines.zh: 我今天有汉语课，老师九点上课。
lines.en: I had a Chinese class today; the teacher starts at nine.
lines.pinyin: wǒ jīntiān yǒu Hànyǔ kè lǎoshī jiǔ diǎn shàngkè

lines.zh: 我跑了十分钟才到学校。
lines.en: I ran for ten minutes before I got to school.
lines.pinyin: wǒ pǎo le shí fēnzhōng cái dào xuéxiào

lines.zh: 老师说：现在是几点？
lines.en: The teacher said: what time is it now?
lines.pinyin: lǎoshī shuō xiànzài shì jǐ diǎn

lines.zh: 我说：对不起，我明天一定早来。
lines.en: I said: sorry, tomorrow I'll definitely come early.
lines.pinyin: wǒ shuō duìbuqǐ wǒ míngtiān yídìng zǎo lái

lines.zh: 她说：昨天你也这么说。
lines.en: She said: you said that yesterday too.
lines.pinyin: tā shuō zuótiān nǐ yě zhè me shuō

lines.zh: 下午我买了一个新手表。
lines.en: In the afternoon I bought a new watch.
lines.pinyin: xiàwǔ wǒ mǎi le yí ge xīn shǒubiǎo

lines.zh: 晚上我看了三次时间。
lines.en: In the evening I checked the time three times.
lines.pinyin: wǎnshang wǒ kàn le sān cì shíjiān

lines.zh: 这个月是我第一次这么努力。
lines.en: This is the first time this month I've tried so hard.
lines.pinyin: zhè ge yuè shì wǒ dì-yī cì zhè me nǔlì

lines.zh: 我的桌子上有一个苹果。
lines.en: There is an apple on my desk.
lines.pinyin: wǒ de zhuōzi shàng yǒu yí ge píngguǒ

lines.zh: 桌子后面是我的椅子，椅子上有一件衣服。
lines.en: Behind the desk is my chair, and on the chair is a piece of clothing.
lines.pinyin: zhuōzi hòumiàn shì wǒ de yǐzi yǐzi shàng yǒu yí jiàn yīfu

lines.zh: 杯子在书的前面，里面有水果茶。
lines.en: The cup is in front of the book, with fruit tea inside.
lines.pinyin: bēizi zài shū de qiánmiàn lǐmiàn yǒu shuǐguǒ chá

lines.zh: 我先喝了一口，然后去做饭。
lines.en: I took a sip first, then went to cook.
lines.pinyin: wǒ xiān hē le yì kǒu ránhòu qù zuò fàn

lines.zh: 米饭做好了，可是菜还没有。
lines.en: The rice was ready but the vegetables were not.
lines.pinyin: mǐfàn zuò hǎo le kě shì cài hái méiyǒu

lines.zh: 我回来的时候，苹果不见了。
lines.en: When I came back the apple was gone.
lines.pinyin: wǒ huí lái de shíhou píngguǒ bú jiàn le

lines.zh: 那儿只有一张纸。
lines.en: There was only a sheet of paper there.
lines.pinyin: nàr zhǐyǒu yì zhāng zhǐ

lines.zh: 纸上写着一个字：饿。
lines.en: One character was written on it: hungry.
lines.pinyin: zhǐ shàng xiě zhe yí ge zì è

lines.zh: 这是我在北京的第一个星期。
lines.en: This was my first week in Beijing.
lines.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ zài Běijīng de dì-yī ge xīngqī

lines.zh: 我想，我的同屋很有意思。
lines.en: I thought: my housemate is quite interesting.
lines.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng wǒ de tóngwū hěn yǒu yìsi

lines.zh: 我在中国坐了很多次出租车。
lines.en: I have taken taxis many times in China.
lines.pinyin: wǒ zài Zhōngguó zuò le hěn duō cì chūzūchē

lines.zh: 今天我从商店坐车回家。
lines.en: Today I took a car home from the shop.
lines.pinyin: jīntiān wǒ cóng shāngdiàn zuò chē huíjiā

lines.zh: 司机很客气，一直跟我说话。
lines.en: The driver was very polite and kept talking to me.
lines.pinyin: sījī hěn kè qì yìzhí gēn wǒ shuōhuà

lines.zh: 他问我：你会说汉语吗？
lines.en: He asked me: can you speak Chinese?
lines.pinyin: tā wèn wǒ nǐ huì shuō Hànyǔ ma

lines.zh: 我说：会一点儿，请说慢一点儿。
lines.en: I said: a little — please speak more slowly.
lines.pinyin: wǒ shuō huì yìdiǎnr qǐng shuō màn yìdiǎnr

lines.zh: 到家的时候，我找不到钱。
lines.en: When I got home I couldn't find my money.
lines.pinyin: dào jiā de shíhou wǒ zhǎo bú dào qián

lines.zh: 我说：对不起，我的钱不见了。
lines.en: I said: I'm sorry, my money is gone.
lines.pinyin: wǒ shuō duìbuqǐ wǒ de qián bú jiàn le

lines.zh: 他说：没关系，你明天给我吧。
lines.en: He said: never mind, give it to me tomorrow.
lines.pinyin: tā shuō méi guānxi nǐ míngtiān gěi wǒ ba

lines.zh: 第二天我给他打电话，说了谢谢。
lines.en: The next day I called him and said thank you.
lines.pinyin: dì-èr tiān wǒ gěi tā dǎ diànhuà shuō le xièxie

lines.zh: 他说：不客气，我们是朋友了。
lines.en: He said: you're welcome — we're friends now.
lines.pinyin: tā shuō búkèqi wǒmen shì péngyou le

lines.zh: 昨天下雨，天气很冷。
lines.en: It rained yesterday and the weather was cold.
lines.pinyin: zuótiān xiàyǔ tiānqì hěn lěng

lines.zh: 我没有带衣服，回家以后就不舒服。
lines.en: I didn't bring a coat, and after getting home I felt unwell.
lines.pinyin: wǒ méiyǒu dài yīfu huíjiā yǐ hòu jiù bù shūfu

lines.zh: 晚上我睡觉睡得很早。
lines.en: In the evening I went to sleep very early.
lines.pinyin: wǎnshang wǒ shuìjiào shuì de hěn zǎo

lines.zh: 今天早上我去了医院。
lines.en: This morning I went to the hospital.
lines.pinyin: jīntiān zǎoshang wǒ qù le yīyuàn

lines.zh: 医生说：你要多喝热水。
lines.en: The doctor said: you should drink more hot water.
lines.pinyin: yīshēng shuō nǐ yào duō hē rè shuǐ

lines.zh: 我问：我可以看电视吗？
lines.en: I asked: can I watch television?
lines.pinyin: wǒ wèn wǒ kěyǐ kàn diànshì ma

lines.zh: 她说：可以，但是不要看得太晚。
lines.en: She said: you can, but don't watch too late.
lines.pinyin: tā shuō kěyǐ dànshì bú yào kàn de tài wǎn

lines.zh: 回家以后我打开电脑，看了一个电影。
lines.en: After getting home I opened my computer and watched a film.
lines.pinyin: huíjiā yǐ hòu wǒ dǎ kāi diànnǎo kàn le yí ge diànyǐng

lines.zh: 这个电影很好，我很高兴。
lines.en: The film was good and I was very happy.
lines.pinyin: zhè ge diànyǐng hěn hǎo wǒ hěn gāoxìng

lines.zh: 我爱这样的下午，虽然下雨，但是我很喜欢。
lines.en: I love afternoons like this — although it rains, I like it a lot.
lines.pinyin: wǒ ài zhè yàng de xiàwǔ suīrán xiàyǔ dànshì wǒ hěn xǐhuan

lines.zh: 我哥哥有一只很聪明的狗。
lines.en: My elder brother has a very clever dog.
lines.pinyin: wǒ gēge yǒu yì zhǐ hěn cōngming de gǒu

lines.zh: 我弟弟有一只白色的猫。
lines.en: My younger brother has a white cat.
lines.pinyin: wǒ dìdi yǒu yì zhǐ báisè de māo

lines.zh: 我妹妹说：它们两个是朋友吗？
lines.en: My younger sister said: are those two friends?
lines.pinyin: wǒ mèimei shuō tāmen liǎng ge shì péngyou ma

lines.zh: 哥哥说：当然不是，它们每天都吵。
lines.en: My brother said: of course not, they quarrel every day.
lines.pinyin: gēge shuō dāngrán bú shì tāmen měitiān dōu chǎo

lines.zh: 有一天，狗把猫的鱼吃了。
lines.en: One day the dog ate the cat's fish.
lines.pinyin: yǒu yì tiān gǒu bǎ māo de yú chī le

lines.zh: 猫非常生气，跑进了我的房间。
lines.en: The cat was furious and ran into my room.
lines.pinyin: māo fēicháng shēngqì pǎo jìn le wǒ de fángjiān

lines.zh: 它躲在门后面，不出来。
lines.en: It hid behind the door and would not come out.
lines.pinyin: tā duǒ zài mén hòumiàn bù chū lái

lines.zh: 我们全家都在找它。
lines.en: Our whole family was looking for it.
lines.pinyin: wǒmen quánjiā dōu zài zhǎo tā

lines.zh: 最后奶奶说：它在我的帽子里。
lines.en: In the end Grandma said: it's inside my hat.
lines.pinyin: zuì hòu nǎinai shuō tā zài wǒ de màozi lǐ

lines.zh: 从那天起，狗见到猫就走开。
lines.en: From that day on, the dog walks away whenever it sees the cat.
lines.pinyin: cóng nà tiān qǐ gǒu jiàn dào māo jiù zǒu kāi

lines.zh: 我在一家公司上班。
lines.en: I work at a company.
lines.pinyin: wǒ zài yì jiā gōngsī shàngbān

lines.zh: 我们的办公室在六层。
lines.en: Our office is on the sixth floor.
lines.pinyin: wǒmen de bàngōngshì zài liù céng

lines.zh: 每天早上我坐公共汽车去上班。
lines.en: Every morning I take the bus to work.
lines.pinyin: měitiān zǎoshang wǒ zuò gōnggòngqìchē qù shàngbān

lines.zh: 有时候我骑自行车，因为路上很堵。
lines.en: Sometimes I ride a bicycle because the road is jammed.
lines.pinyin: yǒu shíhou wǒ qí zìxíngchē yīnwèi lù shàng hěn dǔ

lines.zh: 我的同事很热情，也很认真。
lines.en: My colleagues are warm and also very conscientious.
lines.pinyin: wǒ de tóngshì hěn rèqíng yě hěn rènzhēn

lines.zh: 经理喜欢喝咖啡，一天喝四杯。
lines.en: The manager likes coffee and drinks four cups a day.
lines.pinyin: jīnglǐ xǐhuan hē kāfēi yì tiān hē sì bēi

lines.zh: 今天上午我们开了一个会议。
lines.en: This morning we had a meeting.
lines.pinyin: jīntiān shàngwǔ wǒmen kāi le yí ge huìyì

lines.zh: 他说：这个月的成绩很好，大家辛苦了。
lines.en: He said: this month's results are good; thank you all for your hard work.
lines.pinyin: tā shuō zhè ge yuè de chéngjì hěn hǎo dàjiā xīnkǔ le

lines.zh: 下班以后我们一起去饭店吃饭。
lines.en: After work we went to a restaurant together to eat.
lines.pinyin: xiàbān yǐ hòu wǒmen yìqǐ qù fàndiàn chī fàn

lines.zh: 那天我第一次觉得，工作也可以很快乐。
lines.en: That day, for the first time, I felt work can be a happy thing too.
lines.pinyin: nà tiān wǒ dì-yī cì juéde gōngzuò yě kěyǐ hěn kuàilè

lines.zh: 上个周末我去火车站。
lines.en: Last weekend I went to the train station.
lines.pinyin: shàng ge zhōumò wǒ qù huǒchēzhàn

lines.zh: 我要去南方旅游。
lines.en: I was going travelling in the south.
lines.pinyin: wǒ yào qù nán fāng lǚyóu

lines.zh: 我带了一个行李箱和一张地图。
lines.en: I took a suitcase and a map.
lines.pinyin: wǒ dài le yí ge xínglixiāng hé yì zhāng dìtú

lines.zh: 车站非常大，我找不到我的车。
lines.en: The station was huge and I couldn't find my train.
lines.pinyin: chē zhàn fēicháng dà wǒ zhǎo bú dào wǒ de chē

lines.zh: 我问一个服务员：请问，去上海的车在哪儿？
lines.en: I asked an attendant: excuse me, where is the train to Shanghai?
lines.pinyin: wǒ wèn yí ge fúwùyuán qǐng wèn qù Shànghǎi de chē zài nǎr

lines.zh: 他说：在中间那边，你要快一点儿。
lines.en: He said: over in the middle there — you need to hurry.
lines.pinyin: tā shuō zài zhōngjiān nà biān nǐ yào kuài yìdiǎnr

lines.zh: 我跑了很远，可是还是迟到了。
lines.en: I ran a long way but was still late.
lines.pinyin: wǒ pǎo le hěn yuǎn kě shì háishì chídào le

lines.zh: 车已经开走了。
lines.en: The train had already left.

lines.zh: 冬天下雪，路上一个人也没有。
lines.en: In winter it snows and there is not a soul on the road.
lines.pinyin: dōngtiān xià xuě lù shàng yí ge rén yě méiyǒu

lines.zh: 过去我觉得一年都一样。
lines.en: In the past I thought every year was the same.
lines.pinyin: guòqù wǒ juéde yì nián dōu yíyàng

lines.zh: 现在我知道，每个月都不一样。
lines.en: Now I know that every month is different.
lines.pinyin: xiànzài wǒ zhīdào měi ge yuè dōu bù yíyàng

lines.zh: 最近我常常坐在窗户旁边看外面。
lines.en: Recently I often sit by the window and look outside.
lines.pinyin: zuìjìn wǒ cháng cháng zuò zài chuānghu pángbiān kàn wàimiàn

lines.zh: 看一会儿，我终于明白了时间的意思。
lines.en: After watching for a while, I finally understood what time means.
lines.pinyin: kàn yíhuìr wǒ zhōngyú míngbai le shíjiān de yìsi

lines.zh: 九月，新的学年开始了。
lines.en: In September the new school year began.
lines.pinyin: jiǔ yuè xīn de xuénián kāishǐ le

lines.zh: 我现在是三年级的学生。
lines.en: I am now a third-year student.
lines.pinyin: wǒ xiànzài shì sān niánjí de xuésheng

lines.zh: 我们的校长在楼下等着大家。
lines.en: Our principal was waiting for everyone downstairs.
lines.pinyin: wǒmen de xiàozhǎng zài lóuxià děng zhe dàjiā

lines.zh: 他说：这一年，希望你们认真学习。
lines.en: He said: this year, I hope you will study seriously.
lines.pinyin: tā shuō zhè yì nián xīwàng nǐmen rènzhēn xuéxí

lines.zh: 我最喜欢的课是数学和历史。
lines.en: My favourite subjects are maths and history.
lines.pinyin: wǒ zuì xǐhuan de kè shì shùxué hé lìshǐ

lines.zh: 老师教我们的时候很有意思。
lines.en: The teacher is interesting when she teaches us.
lines.pinyin: lǎoshī jiāo wǒmen de shíhou hěn yǒu yìsi

lines.zh: 每天晚上我要完成很多作业。
lines.en: Every evening I have to finish a lot of homework.
lines.pinyin: měitiān wǎnshang wǒ yào wánchéng hěn duō zuòyè

lines.zh: 我的同学说：他明年想去别的国家留学。
lines.en: My classmate says he wants to study abroad in another country next year.
lines.pinyin: wǒ de tóngxué shuō tā míngnián xiǎng qù bié de guójiā liúxué

lines.zh: 他说：我要了解那里的文化。
lines.en: He said: I want to understand the culture there.
lines.pinyin: tā shuō wǒ yào liǎojiě nàli de wénhuà

lines.zh: 我告诉他：不管在哪里，努力都一样重要。
lines.en: I told him: wherever you are, effort matters just as much.
lines.pinyin: wǒ gàosu tā bùguǎn zài nǎli nǔlì dōu yíyàng zhòngyào

lines.zh: 昨天我们去了一家新开的饭馆。
lines.en: Yesterday we went to a newly opened restaurant.
lines.pinyin: zuótiān wǒmen qù le yì jiā xīn kāi de fànguǎn

lines.zh: 服务员给我们一张很长的菜单。
lines.en: The waiter gave us a very long menu.
lines.pinyin: fúwùyuán gěi wǒmen yì zhāng hěn cháng de càidān

lines.zh: 除了鱼和肉，还有很多别的菜。
lines.en: Besides fish and meat there were many other dishes.
lines.pinyin: chúle yú hé ròu hái yǒu hěn duō bié de cài

lines.zh: 我一般点两个菜，一个汤。
lines.en: I usually order two dishes and one soup.
lines.pinyin: wǒ yìbān diǎn liǎng ge cài yí ge tāng

lines.zh: 我的朋友说：这里的东西很新鲜。
lines.en: My friend said: the food here is very fresh.
lines.pinyin: wǒ de péngyou shuō zhèli de dōngxi hěn xīnxiān

lines.zh: 我尝了一口，有一点儿甜。
lines.en: I tasted a mouthful; it was a little sweet.
lines.pinyin: wǒ cháng le yì kǒu yǒu yìdiǎnr tián

lines.zh: 可是那个汤很差，我们没有喝完。
lines.en: But the soup was poor and we didn't finish it.
lines.pinyin: kě shì nà ge tāng hěn chà wǒmen méiyǒu hē wán

lines.zh: 主要的问题是太咸了。
lines.en: The main problem was that it was too salty.
lines.pinyin: zhǔyào de wèntí shì tài xián le

lines.zh: 吃完以后，一共一百二十元。
lines.en: When we had finished it came to a hundred and twenty yuan altogether.
lines.pinyin: chī wán yǐ hòu yígòng yì bǎi èr shí yuán

lines.zh: 关于价钱，我们都觉得可以接受。
lines.en: As for the price, we all felt it was acceptable.
lines.pinyin: guānyú jiàqian wǒmen dōu juéde kěyǐ jiēshòu

lines.zh: 七月的一个晚上，我家的空调坏了。
lines.en: One evening in July the air conditioner in my home broke.
lines.pinyin: qī yuè de yí ge wǎnshang wǒ jiā de kōngtiáo huài le

lines.zh: 房间里很热，我关了灯也没有用。
lines.en: The room was hot; turning off the light did not help.
lines.pinyin: fángjiān lǐ hěn rè wǒ guān le dēng yě méiyǒu yòng

lines.zh: 我打电话给修理的人，可是没有人接。
lines.en: I called a repairman but nobody answered.
lines.pinyin: wǒ dǎ diànhuà gěi xiūlǐ de rén kě shì méiyǒu rén jiē

lines.zh: 我想了很久，终于找到了一个办法。
lines.en: I thought for a long time and finally found a way.
lines.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng le hěn jiǔ zhōngyú zhǎo dào le yí ge bànfǎ

lines.zh: 我向邻居借了一个电风扇。
lines.en: I borrowed an electric fan from my neighbour.
lines.pinyin: wǒ xiàng línjū jiè le yí ge diànfēngshàn

lines.zh: 这个办法很方便，问题一下子就解决了。
lines.en: That was a convenient solution and the problem was solved at once.
lines.pinyin: zhè ge bànfǎ hěn fāngbiàn wèntí yíxiàzi jiù jiějué le

lines.zh: 第二天，修理的人出现了。
lines.en: The next day the repairman turned up.
lines.pinyin: dì-èr tiān xiūlǐ de rén chūxiàn le

lines.zh: 他说得很清楚：这个空调太旧了。
lines.en: He explained very clearly: this air conditioner is too old.
lines.pinyin: tā shuō de hěn qīngchu zhè ge kōngtiáo tài jiù le

lines.zh: 我决定买一个新的。
lines.en: I decided to buy a new one.
lines.pinyin: wǒ juédìng mǎi yí ge xīn de

lines.zh: 这件事让我明白：很多问题其实很容易。
lines.en: This taught me that many problems are actually easy.
lines.pinyin: zhè jiàn shì ràng wǒ míngbai hěn duō wèntí qíshí hěn róngyì

lines.zh: 早上出门的时候，天很好。
lines.en: When I went out in the morning the weather was fine.
lines.pinyin: zǎoshang chū mén de shíhou tiān hěn hǎo

lines.zh: 所以我没有带伞。
lines.en: So I didn't take an umbrella.
lines.pinyin: suǒyǐ wǒ méiyǒu dài sǎn

lines.zh: 三点一刻的时候，突然下起了大雨。
lines.en: At a quarter past three it suddenly began to pour.
lines.pinyin: sān diǎn yí kè de shíhou tūrán xià qǐ le dà yǔ

lines.zh: 我在街道上等了二十分钟。
lines.en: I waited on the street for twenty minutes.
lines.pinyin: wǒ zài jiēdào shàng děng le èr shí fēnzhōng

lines.zh: 一个女生经过，她把伞给了我。
lines.en: A girl passed by and gave me her umbrella.
lines.pinyin: yí ge nǚshēng jīngguò tā bǎ sǎn gěi le wǒ

lines.zh: 她说：你先用一下，我家很近。
lines.en: She said: use it for now, my home is close.
lines.pinyin: tā shuō nǐ xiān yòng yíxià wǒ jiā hěn jìn

lines.zh: 我说：谢谢你，我明天再还给你。
lines.en: I said: thank you, I'll return it to you tomorrow.
lines.pinyin: wǒ shuō xièxie nǐ wǒ míngtiān zài hái gěi nǐ

lines.zh: 第二天我在学校门口注意找她。
lines.en: The next day I looked out for her carefully at the school gate.
lines.pinyin: dì-èr tiān wǒ zài xuéxiào ménkǒu zhùyì zhǎo tā

lines.zh: 我们又见面了，我请她喝了一杯茶。
lines.en: We met again and I bought her a cup of tea.
lines.pinyin: wǒmen yòu jiànmiàn le wǒ qǐng tā hē le yì bēi chá

lines.zh: 有的时候，一把伞就是一个开始。
lines.en: Sometimes an umbrella is the beginning of something.
lines.pinyin: yǒu de shíhou yì bǎ sǎn jiù shì yí ge kāishǐ

lines.zh: 昨天晚上我看了新闻。
lines.en: Last night I watched the news.
lines.pinyin: zuótiān wǎnshang wǒ kàn le xīnwén

lines.zh: 新闻说：那个城市的环境越来越好了。
lines.en: The news said that city's environment is getting better and better.
lines.pinyin: xīnwén shuō nà ge chéngshì de huánjìng yuèláiyuè hǎo le

lines.zh: 我不太相信，因为我以前去过那里。
lines.en: I didn't quite believe it, because I had been there before.
lines.pinyin: wǒ bú tài xiāngxìn yīnwèi wǒ yǐqián qù guò nàli

lines.zh: 可是我的同事认为这是真的。
lines.en: But my colleague thought it was true.
lines.pinyin: kě shì wǒ de tóngshì rènwéi zhè shì zhēn de

lines.zh: 他说：根据这几年的数字，空气好多了。
lines.en: He said: according to the figures of recent years, the air is much better.
lines.pinyin: tā shuō gēnjù zhè jǐ nián de shùzì kōngqì hǎo duō le

lines.zh: 他还说：这跟每个人的习惯有关系。
lines.en: He also said: this has to do with everyone's habits.
lines.pinyin: tā hái shuō zhè gēn měi ge rén de xíguàn yǒu guānxì

lines.zh: 为了自己的孩子，很多人开始关心环境。
lines.en: For the sake of their own children, many people began to care about the environment.
lines.pinyin: wèile zìjǐ de háizi hěn duō rén kāishǐ guānxīn huánjìng

lines.zh: 一个小小的习惯也会有很大的作用。
lines.en: Even a tiny habit can have a big effect.
lines.pinyin: yí ge xiǎo xiǎo de xíguàn yě huì yǒu hěn dà de zuòyòng

lines.zh: 那天晚上我被这个新闻影响了。
lines.en: That evening I was affected by that piece of news.
lines.pinyin: nà tiān wǎnshang wǒ bèi zhè ge xīnwén yǐngxiǎng le

lines.zh: 从今天开始，我要走路上班。
lines.en: Starting today, I'm going to walk to work.
lines.pinyin: cóng jīntiān kāishǐ wǒ yào zǒulù shàngbān

lines.zh: 我的中文老师说过一句话。
lines.en: My Chinese teacher once said a sentence.
lines.pinyin: wǒ de Zhōngwén lǎoshī shuō guò yí jù huà

lines.zh: 她说：你越说，就越会说。
lines.en: She said: the more you speak, the better you speak.
lines.pinyin: tā shuō nǐ yuè shuō jiù yuè huì shuō

lines.zh: 开始的时候我很害怕，怕说错。
lines.en: At first I was afraid, afraid of making mistakes.
lines.pinyin: kāishǐ de shíhou wǒ hěn hàipà pà shuō cuò

lines.zh: 她说：说错了没关系，那是机会。
lines.en: She said: getting it wrong doesn't matter, that is an opportunity.
lines.pinyin: tā shuō shuō cuò le méi guānxi nà shì jīhuì

lines.zh: 她要求我们每天说十句中文。
lines.en: She required us to say ten Chinese sentences a day.
lines.pinyin: tā yāoqiú wǒmen měitiān shuō shí jù Zhōngwén

lines.zh: 不但要说，而且要大声说。
lines.en: Not only do you have to speak, you have to speak loudly.
lines.pinyin: búdàn yào shuō érqiě yào dà shēng shuō

lines.zh: 三个月以后，我的水平提高得极快。
lines.en: Three months later my level had improved extremely fast.
lines.pinyin: sān ge yuè yǐ hòu wǒ de shuǐpíng tígāo de jí kuài

lines.zh: 我像变成了另一个人。
lines.en: It was as if I had become another person.
lines.pinyin: wǒ xiàng biàn chéng le lìng yí ge rén

lines.zh: 多么奇怪啊，语言真的可以改变一个人。
lines.en: How strange it is — a language really can change a person.
lines.pinyin: duōme qíguài a yǔyán zhēn de kěyǐ gǎi biàn yí ge rén

lines.zh: 现在我需要的不是词典，而是勇气。
lines.en: What I need now is not a dictionary but courage.
lines.pinyin: xiànzài wǒ xūyào de bú shì cídiǎn ér shì yǒngqì

lines.zh: 我们学校的爬山活动在十月。
lines.en: Our school's mountain-climbing outing is in October.
lines.pinyin: wǒmen xuéxiào de páshān huódòng zài shí yuè

lines.zh: 一年有四个季节：春、夏、秋、冬。
lines.en: A year has four seasons: spring, summer, autumn and winter.
lines.pinyin: yì nián yǒu sì ge jìjié chūn xià qiū dōng

lines.zh: 老师说：秋天爬山最好，不冷也不热。
lines.en: The teacher said: autumn is best for climbing, neither cold nor hot.
lines.pinyin: lǎoshī shuō qiūtiān páshān zuì hǎo bù lěng yě bú rè

lines.zh: 那座山有一千二百米高。
lines.en: That mountain is one thousand two hundred metres high.
lines.pinyin: nà zuò shān yǒu yì qiān èr bǎi mǐ gāo

lines.zh: 开始的一段路很平，大家走得很快。
lines.en: The first stretch of road was flat and everyone walked fast.
lines.pinyin: kāishǐ de yí duàn lù hěn píng dàjiā zǒu de hěn kuài

lines.zh: 后来的路又窄又高，其他同学都累了。
lines.en: Later the road was narrow and steep, and the other classmates were tired.
lines.pinyin: hòulái de lù yòu zhǎi yòu gāo qítā tóngxué dōu lèi le

lines.zh: 我在路上认识了一个新朋友。
lines.en: On the way I got to know a new friend.
lines.pinyin: wǒ zài lù shàng rènshi le yí ge xīn péngyou

lines.zh: 他说：如果你走不动，我可以帮你拿包。
lines.en: He said: if you can't walk any further, I can carry your bag.
lines.pinyin: tā shuō rúguǒ nǐ zǒu bú dòng wǒ kěyǐ bāng nǐ ná bāo

lines.zh: 上午十点四十分，我们到了山顶。
lines.en: At ten forty in the morning we reached the top.
lines.pinyin: shàngwǔ shí diǎn sì shí fēn wǒmen dào le shāndǐng

lines.zh: 从山顶往西看，整个城市都在下面。
lines.en: Looking west from the summit, the whole city lay below.
lines.pinyin: cóng shāndǐng wǎng xī kàn zhěnggè chéngshì dōu zài xiàmiàn

lines.zh: 周末的早上，我去了一个很大的市场。
lines.en: On Saturday morning I went to a very big market.
lines.pinyin: zhōumò de zǎoshang wǒ qù le yí ge hěn dà de shìchǎng

lines.zh: 那里有几千个人，非常热闹。
lines.en: There were several thousand people there, very lively.
lines.pinyin: nàli yǒu jǐ qiān ge rén fēicháng rènao

lines.zh: 有人说，一天能来一万人。
lines.en: People say ten thousand can come in a day.
lines.pinyin: yǒu rén shuō yì tiān néng lái yí wàn rén

lines.zh: 我对老东西很感兴趣。
lines.en: I am interested in old things.
lines.pinyin: wǒ duì lǎo dōngxi hěn gǎnxìngqù

lines.zh: 一个老人在卖旧钱，有的已经一百多年了。
lines.en: An old man was selling old money, some of it over a hundred years old.
lines.pinyin: yí ge lǎo rén zài mài jiù qián yǒu de yǐjīng yì bǎi duō nián le

lines.zh: 他给我看了一个五角的硬币。
lines.en: He showed me a fifty-cent coin.
lines.pinyin: tā gěi wǒ kàn le yí ge wǔ jiǎo de yìngbì

lines.zh: 他说：这个不贵，你可以试一试。
lines.en: He said: this one isn't dear, you can give it a try.
lines.pinyin: tā shuō zhè ge bú guì nǐ kěyǐ shì yí shì

lines.zh: 我说：三块钱行吗？
lines.en: I said: would three yuan do?
lines.pinyin: wǒ shuō sān kuài qián xíng ma

lines.zh: 他说：你说得对，就三块。
lines.en: He said: you're right, three yuan then.
lines.pinyin: tā shuō nǐ shuō de duì jiù sān kuài

lines.zh: 为这个小东西，我很开心。
lines.en: I was very pleased over this small thing.
lines.pinyin: wèi zhè ge xiǎo dōngxi wǒ hěn kāixīn

lines.zh: 市场十二点半结束，我最后一个走。
lines.en: The market closes at half past twelve; I was the last to leave.
lines.pinyin: shìchǎng shí èr diǎn bàn jiéshù wǒ zuì hòu yí ge zǒu
